evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/e/j is a three-method interface whose methods resolve to key(), name() and position().
R12 ConfigItemDescriptor (rs/e/h) and ConfigSectionDescriptor (rs/e/m) both implement this exact interface and satisfy key/name/position from their item/section metadata.
RuneLite's config API exposes ConfigObject with the same key(), name(), position() contract and both ConfigItemDescriptor and ConfigSectionDescriptor implement it.
